All four dead lanes had real work on disk, which is what made it survivable.

subject: git index.lock

prevention.ref: if you commit while lanes run, expect this and sweep afterwards

subclass_note: Concurrent commits steal .git/index.lock from a running agent. An agent finished its edits, could not commit, and correctly reported the blocker rather than prompting; its work sat uncommitted on disk.

subject: markdown table parsing

prevention.ref: parse the structure, not the columns

subclass_note: Awk-splitting a markdown table on the pipe character breaks on LaTeX (norms, set-builder braces): 22 of 270 rows looked like they had no provenance tag when they all did. Match the marker by regex instead of by column index.

subject: orchestrator counts reported to the owner

prevention.ref: never quote a grep total as a finding; say candidates, and brief agents that supplied counts are approximate and must be re-derived

subclass_note: Grep totals were quoted to the owner as findings twice in one session: 37 owner-classified amendment routes where the truth was 19, and 85 stale routes of 152 where the truth was 81 of 153 - both from grepping words that also occur in ordinary prose. A third figure, a 14.3x decomposition ratio for number theory, was a lexical artifact of that track harvest wording. The agent that actually parsed the routes reported the discrepancy against the prompt, which is the only reason it surfaced.

subject: track self-report tables

prevention.ref: recompute the arithmetic from the per-pair sections; relabel to a schema value and verify none is cited as a dependency

subclass_note: Two defects the lanes self-reports could not show and only auditing found: a malformed results table with 14 of 18 rows silently missing a column - in the very table asserting the 60-item page ceiling was respected - and an INVENTED SCHEMA VALUE, provenance.statement: directly-checkable, which SCHEMA 3 does not define. The 30 rows were legitimately the permitted checkable-example class, but a non-schema label means the never-load-bearing rule cannot be enforced mechanically.

subject: research/plan-spec.json requires

prevention.ref: at step 0 diff every pair design prerequisites against the transitive closure of the spec requires

subclass_note: A pair prose design block and its plan-spec.json requires drift silently. adjunctions-units-and-counits - the largest fan-out in the plan, 197 unbuilt A pages downstream - is designed with SEVEN page prerequisites and the spec declared ONE. Three of the missing six were not reachable transitively at all, all published, all free to add. Nothing catches this until validate-plan raises undeclared-prereq at step 4, after the Beta has scaffolded and harvested; three landmark worked adjunctions would have had to be dropped or the pair re-scaffolded. The closed stage list has no step-0 id, so caught_at_stage is unknown; the prevention belongs at step 0, before scaffolding.

subject: tools/precheck.mts

prevention.ref: PREVENTIONS A6 - authors keep the citation inside the step prose and inline the equation; the tool behaviour is unchanged

subclass_note: Proof-step display orphaning: a numbered step ending in a standalone display followed by its citation on its own line is SPLIT by precheck stratification - the prose lands in one step and the display plus citation get anchored to whichever step precedes them in file order. It was the cause of the worst fatal defect of the run (the tower-bound regularity lemma) and the first rewrite hit the identical failure, which is how the mechanism was identified. Related: proof-contract reads only a numbered step FIRST LINE, so a mid-step display pushes its citation tag onto a later line and every citation in it becomes invisible.

subject: contract citation quotes

prevention.ref: after any Statement edit regenerate contracts for the edited items AND every item citing them

subclass_note: Editing a Statement silently breaks every contract that quotes it: a citation quote must occur verbatim in the cited item statement section, so ADDING a clause mid-Statement invalidates consumers quotes even though nothing was removed. On this run 38 items were edited and 77 needed contract regeneration. The same shape reappeared at frontier-14 6b (79 errors) and 6c (3 errors).

subject: page splice

prevention.ref: dry-run the splice; chain repeated anchors

subclass_note: Two items declaring the SAME after anchor are inserted in reverse order, putting a theorem before the definition it depends on. Dry-run every splice and chain a repeated anchor to the previously inserted id.

subject: judge stopping rule

prevention.ref: distinguish a fresh nitpick in unchanged text from a regression in changed text before invoking a stopping rule

subclass_note: A judge objection surviving repair is often a REGRESSION the repair caused: round 3 restratification renumbered steps and left two Remarks citing the old numbers, and both lanes caught it. A stopping rule must not fire on a defect the last fix introduced.

subject: .claude/settings.json

prevention.ref: machine-specific modes belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored

subclass_note: defaultMode bypassPermissions in the CHECKED-IN .claude/settings.json broke claude on the VPS, where the repo is checked out as root: Claude Code refuses to start under root/sudo and that guard applies to the permission mode however it is set, not only to the CLI flag. Confirmed empirically - the owner pulled, ran plain claude with no flag, and still got the error. Now acceptEdits, with the allow list doing the prompt suppression.

subject: CLAUDE.md

prevention.ref: adding a rule is zero-sum: write the binding sentence, measure with wc -c AFTER the edit, then cut the equivalent length; verify with the four set-diffs

subclass_note: CLAUDE.md has a hard 40,000-character ceiling and a single new rule (the group-Alpha rule) pushed it to 40,031 - OVER the line - on 2026-08-14. The file had previously grown about 50% past the limit before anyone noticed (59,040 before the owner trim to 39,501). Tightened to 39,947 and then to 39,396 by an owner-instructed dedupe pass. No run is named in the memory file, so run is the pre-frontier-13 fallback although the date falls inside frontier-13.

subject: tools/run-wave.test.mjs

prevention.ref: git stash and re-run before investigating a test failure in the drivers

subclass_note: One run-wave test case - "the terminal step runs its gates, before the commit and the pause" - fails on a CLEAN tree, asserting the driver exit code is 0 and getting 1. Confirmed pre-existing by stashing all working-tree changes. A real open bug in the audit driver A10 terminal step, and a trap: a session that edits dispatch.mjs, preflight.mjs or the drivers will attribute it to its own change.
